strings.en: What are you looking at me for?!{SCROLL}I adore the lovely ladies of the Celadon{NEWLINE}Gym.{SCROLL}How could I ever steal their Pokémon?{SCROLL}Anyone who’d do that to those beauties{NEWLINE}is scum, rotten to the core!

strings.zh: 我听说你这个混蛋胆敢在彩虹百{NEWLINE}货冒犯莉佳大小姐她们！{CLEAR}你这个蠢货！{CLEAR}女神们是你能够随便冒犯的吗？{CLEAR}你赶紧去给女神们道歉去！
strings.en: I heard you, you bastard, dared to{NEWLINE}insult Lady Erika and her girls at the{CLEAR}department store! You moron!{SCROLL}Do you think you can just insult our{NEWLINE}goddesses like that? Go and apologize{CLEAR}to them right now!
